name: WARNING: McCormick Coarse Ground Black Pepper (Piperine Mucosal Irritant & Sharp Flakes)
whyItWorks: Black pepper contains piperine, an alkaloid that increases intestinal epithelial permeability ('leaky gut') and stimulates gastric acid secretion. Coarse ground flakes feature sharp jagged edges that mechanically irritate ulcers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid coarse cracked black pepper crusted on steaks and salads. Use fine sea salt and rubbed herbs for seasoning.
